name: oort
description: oort team instance on Railway: one GHCR image (api · relay · webhook-sender · agent-worker · notifier · push-relay), Caddy public edge, Centrifugo, Postgres 18 + pgvector as an image service with a volume. LiveKit/huddle excluded.

notes.composeTable: Not a docker-compose rendering. scripts/check_compose_env_templates.sh tables infra/rust/*.yml only. This file is a Railway service catalog; env keys come from scripts/self_host_env.sh --platform railway (alias --railway).
notes.platformStamp: MOMO_SELF_HOST_PLATFORM=railway — appended outside the generator heredoc so oort_tier() can read T2 from env alone (#2328). Not a heredoc key. Generator stdout is canonical 45 + this stamp (46). Includes NOTIFIER_POSTGRES_PASSWORD and NOTIFIER_DATABASE_URL (#2193), and WEBHOOK_INGRESS_MASTER_KEY + OUTBOUND_WEBHOOK_MASTER_KEY (#2066, 43→45 / 44→46).
notes.variables: services.<name>.variables is exactly what that service gets. `${{shared.KEY}}` is a Railway reference to a shared variable (the generator's stdout, pasted once as project shared variables). Every other value is typed by hand: a literal, a composed reference, `<operator: …>` (a deployment value that is not a secret), or `<sealed: …>` (a secret set as a sealed variable on that one service, never shared). Each service gets only the keys its compose twin gets — an unread secret in an environment is pure exposure.
notes.startCommand: Railway's start command replaces the image ENTRYPOINT in exec form (docs.railway.com/guides/start-command). The oort image is ENTRYPOINT [momo-rust-entrypoint] + CMD [migrate] and has no binary named api/relay/…, so a bare role name exits 127. Every oort-image service therefore names `momo-rust-entrypoint <role>` itself; `/bin/sh -c` is used only where the service needs a shell (api drive init, push key files).
notes.preDeploy: Pre-deploy is one `/bin/sh -c` string: `VAR=… cmd && …` needs a shell and Railway does not say how it executes the command. It runs in the api service's variables, which is why api carries MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL and the role passwords; the api start command drops them with `env -u` before the server starts, so the running api holds only momo_app (NOBYPASSRLS). Volumes are not mounted during pre-deploy. The api variables are the --claim variant (the team instance); the password variant swaps MOMO_BOOTSTRAP_CLAIM for MOMO_INITIAL_OWNER_PASSWORD, which the start command also drops.
notes.postgres: An image service, not the Railway Postgres template: migrations need PG18 (uuidv7, 001) and pgvector (028), and Railway's default templates add no extensions. Same pin as infra/rust/docker-compose.rust.yml. An image service provides no DATABASE_URL; compose it by hand from a random hex password (README).
notes.centrifugo: The generator writes the compose variable names (CENT_TOKEN_HMAC, CENT_API_KEY, CENTRIFUGO_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, CENT_PROXY_SECRET). Centrifugo v6 reads only its own names, so services.centrifugo.variables maps the four. Without them Centrifugo boots silently, every publish is 401 (API key is empty) and every browser/desktop WebSocket upgrade is 403 (empty allowed_origins).
notes.drive: api stores attachments under MOMO_DRIVE_LOCAL_DIR (/var/lib/oort/drive) on a Railway volume. Railway volumes mount root-owned and the image runs as uid 10001, so api sets RAILWAY_RUN_UID=0, creates and chowns the directory, then drops to momo with setpriv. The init-and-drop step belongs in the image entrypoint long term (#2574).
notes.push: push-relay holds the APNs .p8, notifier holds the Ed25519 relay signing key. Railway has no file secrets, so each start command decodes one sealed base64 variable into /dev/shm (tmpfs) with umask 077, unsets the variable, and passes the path. No /dev/shm → boot refusal, never a key on disk. MOMO_APNS_ENV=production: TestFlight and App Store builds register production tokens.
notes.webhookSenderKeys: webhook-sender must be given OUTBOUND_WEBHOOK_MASTER_KEY explicitly, with the same value as api (the same shared reference). #2066 deleted the binary's JWT_HMAC fallback, and this file is not a compose rendering — there is no `${VAR:?}` to catch a variable that reached api but not this service. Its DSN resolves WEBHOOK_SENDER_DATABASE_URL → RELAY_DATABASE_URL → DATABASE_URL, so the generator's RELAY_DATABASE_URL is enough when no dedicated credential is set.
notes.livekit: Excluded (huddle deferred). Do not add a LiveKit service.
notes.tls: Railway terminates HTTPS on the caddy service. Caddyfile.railway is the public Caddyfile with an internal-HTTP listener only — not auto_https off plus a bare :8080 site. It pins X-Forwarded-Proto https on the three api upstream blocks, because Caddy otherwise forwards the plain-HTTP scheme it received and the api then advertises ws:// and an http:// device-link origin.
notes.healthcheck: caddy's Railway healthcheck arrives with Host healthcheck.railway.app, which matches no site, so Caddy answers an empty 200: it proves only that Caddy listens. api's healthcheck is the real one (/healthz is 200 only with database ok).
notes.migrate: Image command migrate does not provision runtime roles and apply 001..NNN in one process. MOMO_RUNTIME_ROLE_PROVISION=1 applies bootstrap_runtime_roles.sql and exits. A second invocation with MOMO_BOOTSTRAP_RUNTIME_ROLES=0 migrates. api.preDeployCommand sequences both against MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL so the running api keeps DATABASE_URL=momo_app (RLS).

api.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'set -eu; [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || { echo "api: RAILWAY_RUN_UID=0 이 필요하다 (드라이브 볼륨은 root 소유로 붙는다)" >&2; exit 78; }; d="${MOMO_DRIVE_LOCAL_DIR:?MOMO_DRIVE_LOCAL_DIR is required}"; mkdir -p "$d"; chown momo:momo "$d"; exec setpriv --reuid=momo --regid=momo --init-groups env -u MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL -u MOMO_APP_POSTGRES_PASSWORD -u RELAY_POSTGRES_PASSWORD -u WORKER_POSTGRES_PASSWORD -u NOTIFIER_POSTGRES_PASSWORD -u MOMO_INITIAL_OWNER_PASSWORD HOME=/home/momo momo-rust-entrypoint api'

notifier.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'set -eu; umask 077; [ -d /dev/shm ] && [ -w /dev/shm ] || { echo "notifier: /dev/shm(tmpfs) 없음 — 서명키를 디스크에 쓰지 않는다" >&2; exit 78; }; : "${RELAY_SIGNING_KEY_B64:?RELAY_SIGNING_KEY_B64 is required}"; k=/dev/shm/relay-signing-key.pem; printf %s "$RELAY_SIGNING_KEY_B64" | base64 -d >"$k"; [ -s "$k" ]; unset RELAY_SIGNING_KEY_B64; export MOMO_PUSH_RELAY_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH="$k"; exec momo-rust-entrypoint notifier'

variables.RELAY_SIGNING_KEY_B64: <sealed: base64 of the Ed25519 PKCS#8 private key PEM from scripts/push_relay_keygen.sh>

push-relay.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'set -eu; umask 077; [ -d /dev/shm ] && [ -w /dev/shm ] || { echo "push-relay: /dev/shm(tmpfs) 없음 — APNs 키를 디스크에 쓰지 않는다" >&2; exit 78; }; : "${APNS_KEY_P8_B64:?APNS_KEY_P8_B64 is required}"; k=/dev/shm/apns-key.p8; printf %s "$APNS_KEY_P8_B64" | base64 -d >"$k"; [ -s "$k" ]; unset APNS_KEY_P8_B64; export MOMO_APNS_KEY_PATH="$k"; exec momo-rust-entrypoint push-relay'

variables.MOMO_RELAY_SERVERS: <operator: {"oort-team":"<raw Ed25519 public key base64 printed by scripts/push_relay_keygen.sh>"}>
